# IxDF (Interaction Design Foundation)

> Global leader in design education offering 40+ UX/UI courses, certifications, job placement, and community networking for 1.1M+ learners across 493 cities.

IxDF provides industry-recognized design certifications in partnership with leading companies like Adobe, IBM, and MIT. The platform combines structured learning with job placement services, design tools access, and a thriving global community of UX/UI professionals.

## Key Topics

- UX/UI Design
- Design Certification
- AI for Designers
- Human-Centered Design
- Design Thinking
- Career Development
- Job Placement
- Design Systems
- User Research
- Online Learning
- Professional Development
- Global Community
- Design Education
- AI Design
- Design Tools

## Core Learning Programs

- [UX/UI Design Courses & Certifications](https://ixdf.org/courses): Main courses catalog with 40+ industry-recognized certifications and unlimited access model for career advancement.
- [AI for Designers Course](https://ixdf.org/courses/ai-for-designers): Beginner course on integrating AI tools into design workflows and AI-driven design practices.
- [Design for the 21st Century with Don Norman](https://ixdf.org/courses/design-for-the-21st-century): Course by Don Norman on human-centered design for solving global challenges sustainably.
- [Live and On-Demand Master Classes](https://ixdf.org/master-classes): Premium learning offering with live/on-demand sessions from design leaders on AI and UX topics.
- [Human-Centered Design for AI Master Class](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/human-centered-design-for-ai): Master class on ethical AI design and human-centered practices by Niwal Sheikh.
- [AI Healthcare UX Master Class](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/ai-in-healthcare-ux-how-you-can-design-trustworthy-interfaces-in-high-stakes-environment): Master class on designing trustworthy AI interfaces for healthcare by Seulki Lee.

## Career & Job Services

- [Get a Job in Design and AI](https://ixdf.org/design-a-life-you-love): Career-focused landing page showcasing IxDF's job-ready design courses and AI design training.
- [UX/UI Design Job Board](https://ixdf.org/jobs): World's largest design job board with AI-powered matching for thousands of active UX/UI roles globally.
- [Join IxDF Membership](https://ixdf.org/join): Membership signup page with pricing, certification access, and job placement features.

## Community & Networking

- [Global UX/UI Design Community](https://ixdf.org/community): Global community hub with local meetups, networking, and jobs across 493 cities worldwide.
- [NYC Local Community Group](https://ixdf.org/local-group/north-america/united-states/nyc): NYC local community group page for IxDF members with meetups and networking opportunities.

## Resources & Tools

- [Design Library](https://ixdf.org/library): Free resource library with 690 videos and 1,730 articles on design thinking and UX trends.
- [Premium Designer Tools](https://ixdf.org/designer-tools): Membership benefit showcasing exclusive discounts on design tools like FluidUI and ProtoPie worth $6,369.
- [Template Bundles](https://ixdf.org/template-bundles): Ready-to-use design template bundles for accelerating UX/UI design workflows.
